005package org.wpilib.util.option;
006
007import static java.util.Objects.requireNonNull;
008import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
009
010import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
011import java.util.function.Function;
012import java.util.function.Predicate;
013import java.util.function.Supplier;
014import java.util.stream.Stream;
015
016/**
017 * An option type that does not contain a value.
018 *
019 * @param <T> The type of the optional value
020 */
021public record None<T>() implements Option<T> {
022  // This type has no state and is immutable, so all instances are functionally identical.
023  // Using a singleton cuts down on unnecessary object allocation.
024  @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
025  private static final None NONE = new None();
026
027  /**
028   * Gets a {@code None} instance representing the absence of a value of type {@code T}.
029   *
030   * <p>Because {@code None} is stateless, this method returns the same singleton object every time
031   * it's invoked.
032   *
033   * @param <T> The type of values that could have been stored in the optional value.
034   * @return A {@code None} instance representing no data for type {@code T}.
035   */
036  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
037  public static <T> None<T> none() {
038    return (None<T>) NONE;
039  }
040
041  @Override
042  public T orElse(T fallbackValue) {
043    requireNonNullParam(fallbackValue, "fallbackValue", "Option.orElse");
044    return fallbackValue;
045  }
046
047  @Override
048  public T orElseGet(Supplier<? extends T> fallbackSupplier) {
049    requireNonNullParam(fallbackSupplier, "fallbackSupplier", "Option.orElseGet");
050
051    var fallbackValue = fallbackSupplier.get();
052    requireNonNull(fallbackValue, "The supplier passed to Option.orElseGet returned null");
053    return fallbackValue;
054  }
055
056  @Override
057  public T orElseThrow() {
058    throw new NoSuchElementException("This option has no value");
059  }
060
061  @Override
062  public <X extends Throwable> T orElseThrow(Supplier<? extends X> exceptionSupplier) throws X {
063    requireNonNullParam(exceptionSupplier, "exceptionSupplier", "Option.orElseThrow");
064
065    var exception = exceptionSupplier.get();
066    requireNonNull(exception, "The supplier passed to Option.orElseThrow returned null");
067    throw exception;
068  }
069
070  @Override
071  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
072  public Option<T> or(Supplier<? extends Option<? extends T>> supplier) {
073    requireNonNullParam(supplier, "supplier", "Option.or");
074
075    var other = supplier.get();
076    requireNonNull(other, "The supplier passed to Option.or returned null");
077    return (Option<T>) other;
078  }
079
080  @Override
081  public Option<T> filter(Predicate<? super T> predicate) {
082    requireNonNullParam(predicate, "predicate", "Option.filter");
083
084    return none();
085  }
086
087  @Override
088  public <R> Option<R> map(Function<? super T, ? extends R> mapper) {
089    requireNonNullParam(mapper, "mapper", "Option.map");
090
091    return none();
092  }
093
094  @Override
095  public <R> Option<R> flatMap(Function<? super T, ? extends Option<? extends R>> mapper) {
096    requireNonNullParam(mapper, "mapper", "Option.flatMap");
097
098    return none();
099  }
100
101  @Override
102  public Stream<T> stream() {
103    return Stream.empty();
104  }
105}
